lesson: Bai hoc tu lan noi loss-only driver (14/09/2026). Ba loi lam test loss PASS gia hoac FAIL oan, deu do HARNESS chu khong do plugin: (1) Staging bang API - probe lay item khoi inventory bang Inventory.setItem(slot,null) roi World.dropItem. Khong co PlayerDropItemEvent nen khong co row DROP; UnexplainedRemovalPolicy coi la unexplained va ItemLossListener.scanOnlinePlayers ghi CLEARED cho item dang nam duoi dat. Row rac do roi vao cua so cua case survive lam no FAIL oan (log: 'loss code=... reason=CLEARED' + rowsAfter=1). Cach dung: bot nem that ({'toss':true}) roi probe NHAN NUOI entity tim duoc quanh player. (2) Hazard dat sai luc - dat FIRE ngay sau khi drop o y+1: item con dang roi nen o lua khong co de, lua tat truoc khi item toi (healthBefore=5 healthAfter=5 fireTicks=0 - PASS rong). Cach dung: doi entity.isOnGround() roi moi dat FIRE vao chinh o cua no, poll health thay vi dem tick. Khong dung LAVA cho case survive - lava giet item, do la burn path. (3) Chunk.unload() im lang khong lam gi khi con player giu ticket - lan chay that cho loaded=true, case 'khong ghi loss khi unload' khong test gi ca. Cach dung: teleport ca hai player di xa truoc, luu toa do cu vao config, retry unload va CHECK !chunk.isLoaded(). Phep kiem chong vacuous: verifier phai assert healthAfter<healthBefore, unload loaded=='false', burn gone=true va reason=='BURNED'; moi rang buoc do co mot negative-control test rieng trong test_contracts.py. Sau unload phai co buoc lossrehome (reload dung chunk cu + nhat lai) truoc khi burn, vi entity nam trong chunk da bi evict.
